ABOUT THE PRODUCT

Cleaning Cloth Roll.

The perforated cleaning cloth roll is made of sheets that you tear off as needed, making it practical for kitchen and general surface cleaning.

A 26 × 405 cm roll, available in yellow, blue and pink, supplied in hang-up packaging.

  • Perforated sheets
  • 26 × 405 cm roll
  • Yellow, blue and pink
  • Hang-up packaging
